scope: s 7 (the contribution duty), s 15(1)-(6) (withdrawal), s 16 (the medisave restrictions) and s 25(1) (who may nominate, and how a large nomination is split), with the s 2 definition of 'applicable person'. STILL A SMALL FRACTION of an Act of about 911,000 characters. ADDED 11 Oct 2026 for REQ-0001 and REQ-0012: First Schedule paragraphs 1 and 7 (contribution rates from 1 January 2026 for citizens and second-year-plus permanent residents, ordinary wages only, the Ordinary Wage Ceiling and rounding), s 24(3A) (moneys on death outside the estate) and s 25(5) (nomination revoked by marriage). ADDED 11 Oct 2026 for REQ-0002 and REQ-0003: s 13(4) crediting into the accounts, from the CPF Board's published allocation ratios from 1 January 2026 (the Minister's direction is not legislation; not deposited); and the Central Provident Fund (Exemption) Order 2018 (S 61/2018), paras 2 and 3 and the Schedule, IN THE VERSION AS MADE (in force 1 Jan to 1 Feb 2018), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/CPFA1953-S61-2018.txt. NOT ENCODED: additional wages, the graduated permanent-resident rates, s 15AA, s 15(4), the housing and investment charges, the rest of s 25 and s 25A, and everything from Part 3A onwards. The prescribed retirement sum, the contribution rates and the Minister's maximum nomination amount are facts supplied; the regulations were not retrieved.
